title: Intel upsizes stock offering to $20 billion at $95 per share as AI demand accelerates
summary: Intel has significantly increased its stock offering to $20 billion, pricing shares at $95 each, in response to the accelerating demand for artificial intelligence technologies. This move reflects the broader trend among technology giants, who have invested trillions to meet the growing needs for AI infrastructure. As companies race to capitalize on AI advancements, Intel's decision underscores the critical role of funding in sustaining innovation in this rapidly evolving sector.
